title: Desk item v0: queries
description: How items are asked for and handed over: a query (kinds, sources, full-text search, conditions, sort, cursor paging), a page of items, and the change of one item (ADR 0032).

ItemQuery.description: Which items, in which order, how many. Every part narrows: kinds and sources, the full-text search and each where condition (all of them must hold).

sources.description: Absent means every source the caller may read.

text.description: Full-text search over title, body and the kinds' text fields.

sort.description: The first entry sorts first; absent is updatedAt, newest first.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous ItemPage, to read the next one. Opaque.

limit.description: Items per page: 50 when absent, 500 at most.

SourceSelector.description: A connector id (every instance of it), connector/instance (one instance), or, in a view binding only, $ and the name of one of the view's requires entries ($calendar).

FieldPath.description: A dotted path into an item: start, from.email, raw.labels, points.0.v.

ConditionOp.description: How a condition compares. in takes an array of values; contains matches a substring or an array element; exists takes no value, or false for a missing field.

value.description: What the field is compared with. Any JSON value.

ItemPage.description: One page of a query's items.

cursor.description: Pass it as ItemQuery.cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

ItemChange.description: What changed about one item: it is new or different (upserted), or gone (removed).

ItemUpserted.description: The item is new, or replaces the one with the same source and id.

ItemRemoved.description: The item with this source and id is gone.
